Woman says she got a home with Chhathi Maiya's blessings:Prasad distributed to SDRF personnel after puja in Lucknow; children burst firecrackers
stories.summary: A large number of devotees gathered at more than 4,000 ghats across Uttar Pradesh from 4 am on Monday to celebrate Chhath Mahaparv. Women stood in knee-deep water, waiting for sunrise before offering Arghya to the Sun God. Traditional songs dedicated to Chhathi Maiya echoed across the ghats, while fireworks lit up the sky. Women also applied sindoor to each other and performed the rituals amid chants of praise for Chhathi Maiya. In Lucknow, devotees gathered near decorated altars at the ghats early in the morning. Children burst firecrackers, while women observing the fast offered Arghya as soon as the Sun rose. At the Gomti Riverfront Ghat, a woman said she had got a home with Chhathi Maiya's blessings. Women also distributed prasad to SDRF personnel deployed for security. The festival saw several special moments across the state. In Kushinagar, Afsana Khatoon, a Muslim woman, observed the Chhath fast after her ailing son recovered. She reached the ghat with her husband, Ali Mohammad, and son to offer Arghya. In Gorakhpur, MP Ravi Kishan carried a daura (basket of puja offerings) on his head and sang a song dedicated to Chhathi Maiya. Meanwhile, French tourist Tania visited Kashi to witness the festival. She said she had read about Chhath on the internet but got to experience it in person this time.

stories.title: Whose political fortunes will be affected if Azam is released?:Owaisi could dent Akhilesh's influence; Abdullah to take charge if he remains in jail
stories.summary: A hearing will take place today in the Allahabad High Court regarding the ED's action against SP leader Azam Khan and his bail plea. On 31 October, Azam was taken into custody by the ED from outside Rampur District Jail, even though he had been granted bail in the dual PAN card case. Senior advocate Abhishek Manu Singhvi will be present in the division bench of the Allahabad High Court to present Azam Khan's side. Following the hearing, two scenarios appear to be emerging based on the possible outcomes. In both situations, it is certain that Azam will not contest elections. However, he will definitely make an impact on several seats, especially in Western UP, in the 2027 assembly elections. Let us understand step by step how this will happen… The Supreme Court has ordered the Allahabad High Court to conduct an expedited hearing in Azam Khan's case. Abhishek Manu Singhvi himself is coming to argue on Azam's behalf. If Azam gets bail ahead of the assembly elections, it will be a major political event. If Azam Khan is released, all eyes will be fixed on the political coordination between Akhilesh Yadav and Azam Khan. If this happens, what changes could occur in UP politics? Let us understand this in 3 points- 1. Azam will be a star campaigner for SP Azam Khan and Abdullah cannot contest elections right now because the Representation of the People Act, 1951 applies to them. It contains a provision that one cannot contest elections if sentenced to 2 years or more in criminal cases. However, Azam can be a star campaigner for the SP. By staying among Muslim voters in Western, Central, and Purvanchal regions, he will strengthen the SP. Azam is known for his emotional speeches. During the elections, his demand may remain higher in seats where the number of Muslim voters is greater. 2. Will reduce Owaisi's influence The challenge the SP is facing from AIMIM's Owaisi will have strong prospects of diminishing considerably, because once again the SP will have Azam's face to unite Muslim voters. Currently, Owaisi is trying to stir the emotions of Muslims; if he comes out, Azam Khan will do the same work for the SP and try to blunt Owaisi's edge. 3. Will get responsibility for several seats in Western UP Azam Khan has a strong mass base in Western Uttar Pradesh, especially in the Rampur and Moradabad divisions. In Azam Khan's prolonged absence, the SP's minority leadership was feeling a void. His release will give the party a vocal face, which could make the inclination of Muslim voters even clearer in the upcoming elections. Akhilesh may hand over the responsibility of Western UP seats to Azam. What will happen if Azam is not released… Now, even if the court decides to keep Azam Khan inside jail, there will still be major political upheaval. Following this decision, the BJP could go on the offensive against the SP over issues of law and order and corruption. On the other hand, the SP could turn this decision into an issue of 'political vendetta' among the public and try to garner sympathy votes among the minority community. What scenario will emerge after the possibility of Azam remaining in jail? Understand this too- 1. Abdullah could become a star campaigner, taking Azam's place The biggest challenge for the SP at this time is to consolidate the Muslim voter. In this era of Hindutva politics, if the Muslim voter shifts towards AIMIM, Congress, or BSP, the SP's seats could decrease. Therefore, Azam can play a role in formulating political strategy. From inside jail, he can work on uniting candidates, issues, and disgruntled workers across seats. His son Abdullah can take on the task of handling the electoral battlefield for him. He can work on establishing coordination within the SP's local organisation in Rampur and surrounding seats. 2. SP may play the sympathy card In the event of bail not being granted, the SP will project it as a 'political conspiracy' and 'tyranny'. Through this, an attempt will be made to gather public sympathy. The party will try to send a message among the minority community that a prominent Muslim face is deliberately being kept in jail. 3. Responsibility of saving the political legacy In Azam Khan's absence, the biggest challenge before Abdullah will be to prevent the family's political base from disintegrating. Maintaining the organisational and personal influence that Azam Khan has had in Rampur will not be easy. Along with this, Abdullah may also be given the responsibility of winning as many Muslim-dominated seats as possible. Expert says - Azam is influential, no matter where he is Senior journalist Zaigham Murtaza says - Azam has been such a leader in UP politics whose influence has not been limited to just one assembly constituency. His political grip in Rampur, his identity among Muslim voters, and his stature within the SP set him apart from other leaders. However, over the past few years, legal manoeuvring has continuously affected his political activism. What is the case and what has happened so far? The current link in Azam Khan's troubles is connected to a case of alleged financial irregularities related to Mohammad Ali Jauhar University and the Jauhar Trust. Three dates are important to understand the entire sequence of events. Following this, the ED also secured four days' custody of Azam Khan for interrogation. The agency is investigating the financial transactions of the Jauhar Trust and alleged irregularities in the construction of the university. It has also emerged that Azam is unable to answer the ED's questions regarding financial transactions. If relief is not granted by the High Court, Azam Khan will still have the option to challenge this order in the Supreme Court. However, the process of hearing and verdict in the apex court could drag on for a long time.

stories.title: BJP workers say rebel SP leader Pooja Pal is acceptable:She rarely mingles with people; find out whom Chail voters are backing
stories.summary: Pooja Pal, who helped the Samajwadi Party (SP) win the Chail Assembly seat in Kaushambi for the first time in 2022, has now switched sides and joined the BJP. The party has also given her a senior position, making her a state vice-president. However, she faces several challenges on the ground ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. Around 70% of voters in Chail belong to the OBC and Dalit communities. Pooja Pal herself belongs to the OBC category, but building a strong connect with people will not be easy for her. BJP workers indicate that people still remember the work done by former MLA Sanjay Gupta. "Pooja Pal was earlier with the Samajwadi Party and later joined the BJP. She has not yet established her identity through development work," several party workers said. The message is clear. BJP workers have accepted Pooja Pal, but some office-bearers complain that she rarely meets people and does not answer phone calls. There were mixed reactions when people were asked who could be the BJP candidate from Chail in 2027. At the ground level, we also met people who want Sanjay Kumar, who helped the BJP win Chail in 2017, to be given the ticket again. Read the ground report… Shakti Kendra convenor Kanhaiya Sahu, whom we met near Chail tehsil, was clear about his views. He said, "The political atmosphere in Chail has changed considerably. The SP is nowhere to be seen. The BJP wave among the public remains strong. In 2022, the SP spread rumours that the Constitution would be abolished, which is why the BJP lost. But that will not happen this time." We asked him whether Pooja Pal, who defeated the BJP in 2022, could now be given the responsibility of winning the seat for the party. Kanhaiya said, "Pooja Pal is welcome in the party. She has been accepted in the organisation as a state vice-president. She should serve the organisation and build people's trust. If the party gives her the ticket, we will see then. If the views of workers like us are considered, we would want former MLA Sanjay Gupta to be given another chance because people have always liked him. However, we will work according to whatever direction the party gives us." Workers say she rarely answers calls; they need to inform her about developments in the constituency… BJP Chail mandal vice-president Arvind Tiwari said, "We will ensure the victory of whoever the organisation gives the ticket to. We are unable to get through to Pooja Pal on the number we have. We only have party-related work to discuss. I am not the only one; several people in the constituency have the same complaint." Off camera, several other workers also said that they were unable to contact her and needed to inform her about developments in the constituency and matters related to the party. After understanding the views of BJP office-bearers, we went out to speak to the public. During conversations with Bhaskar, both anger and support among voters were evident. Opinions about Pooja Pal's performance varied across different areas. 'People are upset over what happened to students' Karan, from Manori market, spoke about the need for a change over issues such as inflation and unemployment. He said, "Last time, we campaigned for Pooja Pal. We will not do so this time. The atmosphere here is going to change now. People are upset over what the government did to students recently. Everyone saw what happened during the MLC elections. There could be a major political upset in 2027 as well." Shrikant, from Muradpur, also appeared unhappy with the poor condition of roads and the lack of development in the area. He said, "Pooja Pal moved from the SP to the BJP. That was her personal decision, but she has not done any major work here. We will elect an SP MLA from this constituency." People say they want improvements in education and healthcare Advocate Tej Singh Verma said, "Pooja Pal did not listen to people's grievances and could not deliver development either. A water tank was built in our village, but even after five years, water has not reached people's homes. On what basis should people vote?" He further said, "Nobody in the entire constituency knows where Pooja Pal has held public meetings. It is easy for politicians to bring crowds by paying people, but winning the public's trust is the most important thing. Going by the current situation, Pooja Pal will not get our votes. We want improvements in education and healthcare." 'We will elect whoever the BJP chooses' In contrast, Mahendra Singh Patel, also from Muradpur, supported both the BJP and Pooja Pal, citing the law and order situation. He said, "If we do not choose the BJP, what is the alternative? If the BJP gives Pooja Pal the ticket, we will vote for her. We will vote for whoever the party fields as its candidate." Devendra Pandey, from Charwa, believes that Pooja is helping people and could win if the BJP fields her in the election. However, he said she does not have much of an independent political standing outside the party. The BJP has won the Chail Assembly seat in Kaushambi district only twice. Its first MLA, Shivdani, won the election in 1993. The second time, Sanjay Kumar Gupta won the Assembly election in 2017, helping the BJP establish its presence in Chail. In 2022, Sanjay Gupta was expected to be fielded again, but the seat went to Apna Dal (S). During a visit to Kaushambi, Union Home Minister Amit Shah had said about Sanjay Gupta, "He stepped aside at my request. He will be taken care of in the future." The Bhaskar team also put some questions to him. Question: Will you stake your claim to the ticket for the 2027 Assembly elections? Answer: The party has conducted several surveys for the Chail seat and is conducting more. This time, the party will make changes in a large number of constituencies, and candidates will also be shifted from one seat to another. The ticket will go to whoever fits the party's survey findings. If I fit the criteria, I may get it. If Pooja Pal fits the criteria, she will get the ticket. Question: You did not say anything when your claim to the Chail seat was dropped in 2022 either. Answer: In 2022, the seat went to Apna Dal (S). It was a policy decision by the party. I did not comment at the time, nor did I say anything during the five years that followed. Party decisions are taken as part of a strategy. All we would say is that the party should choose whoever it believes can win the seat. SP claims development in Chail has come to a standstill SP district general secretary Ghulam Hussain alleged that Pooja's decision to switch parties had left people feeling cheated and that development in Chail had come to a standstill. He said people had understood how politicians changed parties for their own benefit. "People had not voted for Pooja alone; they had brought the SP to power," he said. After different views emerged over the possibility of candidates contesting from Chail, the Dainik Bhaskar team tried several times to contact BJP MLA Pooja Pal. However, the team could not speak to her. There is also speculation in political circles that Pooja Pal is more interested in contesting from the Allahabad West Assembly seat in Prayagraj rather than Chail. She has been elected MLA from that seat twice. However, BJP MLA and former minister Siddharth Nath Singh is himself a strong contender for the Allahabad West seat. Seat became unreserved after 2012; BJP and SP have both won it since then Kaushambi district has three Assembly constituencies: Manjhanpur, Sirathu and Chail. The SP won all three seats in 2022. In Sirathu, even Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya lost the election. Chail has a sizeable Dalit population. This is why the seat remained reserved for Scheduled Caste candidates from 1957 to 2012. The status changed in 2012, when the seat was moved to the general category. The constituency was once dominated by the Congress and the BSP, but both parties now appear to be in third and fourth place, respectively, in terms of public support. The BSP continued to win the seat in 2002, 2007 and 2012. However, after it became an unreserved constituency, BJP's Sanjay Kumar became its MLA.

stories.title: Businessman’s son falls from sixth floor in Kanpur:He had gone to meet his girlfriend, body bears 13 injuries; he was the family’s only child
stories.summary: Sambhav Khandelwal, the 22-year-old son of a businessman, died after falling from the sixth floor of an apartment in Kanpur. The incident took place at around 3:40 p.m. on Saturday. CCTV footage of it surfaced at 10 p.m. on Sunday. The footage shows Sambhav falling onto the road outside the apartment. People present there immediately ran to him after seeing him fall and took him to hospital. Doctors declared him dead. Sambhav was the only son of the owner of Guru Kripa Paper. He had reached the Rudra Greens apartment in Singhpur at around 3 p.m. on Saturday. He is said to have come to meet his girlfriend, who lived there. A panel of doctors conducted the post-mortem examination on Sunday. According to the report, a total of 13 injuries were found on his body. It confirmed that he died of excessive blood loss. However, it is still unclear under what circumstances Sambhav fell from the sixth floor. The young woman's maternal uncle was also present at the time of the incident Vishal Khandelwal, a resident of Gumti Number Five, is in the paper business under the name Guru Kripa Paper. He is also the owner and editor of a newspaper. His son Sambhav reached the Rudra Greens apartment in Singhpur on Saturday afternoon. It is being reported that he had come to meet his girlfriend, who lived on the sixth floor of Tower B-2. The young woman lived there with her mother and younger brother. Some time later, Sambhav fell from the sixth floor. He was taken to Paras Hospital in Bithoor in critical condition, where doctors declared him dead. The young woman's honorary maternal uncle was also present at the spot at the time of the incident. Family Suspects Murder, Police Begin Investigation As soon as the family learnt of Sambhav's death, they reached the hospital. After seeing the body, they suspected murder. The family said that if Sambhav had fallen from such a height, the injury marks on his body would have been more visible. There were scratch marks on his arm and leg, while he had also suffered an injury to his head. Following the family's allegations, the police began investigating the case. Forensic team collects evidence, questions four people including girlfriend Bithoor police reached the spot after receiving the information and inspected the scene. The forensic team collected evidence from the apartment's sixth floor to the spot where the young man fell. The team also carried out an examination at the hospital. Police have detained Sambhav's girlfriend, her mother, younger brother and the young woman's maternal uncle by informal relationship, and started questioning them. Police are investigating all aspects and working to piece together the sequence of events. DCP says investigation continues into what happened on the sixth floor DCP West S.M. Qasim Abidi said CCTV footage of the young man falling from the apartment has emerged. It shows him falling to the ground. However, an investigation is under way into what happened to him on the sixth floor and the circumstances in which he fell. He said no complaint had been received from any party so far. Once a complaint is received, a case will be registered and action will be taken according to the law.

stories.title: Couple murdered, accused sexually assaults bodies:Kannauj police arrest him after shooting both legs; says he went to steal
stories.summary: A husband and wife were murdered in Kannauj, Uttar Pradesh, on the night of November 4. After the murders, the accused also sexually assaulted the woman's body. The accused was arrested after a police encounter at around 4 pm on Sunday in the Gursahaiganj area. He was shot in both legs during the encounter. The young man had earlier been jailed for the murder of two people. Even then, police had arrested him after shooting him in the leg. First, know the full story... Sanjeev Katheria lived with his wife, Shikha, and their two-year-old daughter, Vanya, at the old CHC in Gursahaiganj. Sanjeev worked at a ticket vending machine at the railway station. On the morning of 5 November, a relative of Sanjeev reached his house. He knocked on the gate, but it did not open. The relative then climbed onto the roof and looked into the courtyard, where he saw the blood-soaked bodies of Sanjeev and his wife, Shikha. Vanya was sitting beside her father's body, crying. She was also injured. The police then reached the scene and began their investigation. Teams were deployed to arrest the perpetrator. Now read how the police tracked down the accused SP Vinod Kumar said the incident was seen in CCTV recordings from the areas surrounding the scene. A suspect was spotted in the footage. He was identified as Yogesh alias Panga, a resident of Bhojapur village in the Talgram police station area. The police began searching for him. On Sunday, they learnt that Yogesh was in the forest of the Forest Department on Tirva Road in Gurसहायगंज. The police surrounded the area. During this, Yogesh fired three shots at the police. In retaliatory action, the police opened fire, and bullets hit both his legs. The police arrested him. Now read the murder accused's confession... During police questioning, Yogesh said, "I entered the house through the roof intending to commit theft. When I reached the room, Sanjeev and Shikha were awake. I then attacked Sanjeev on the head with a stick, killing him. After that, I strangled Shikha to death." He then raped Shikha's body. After this, he fled with ₹5,000 and the ATM card kept in the house. The SP said that after Yogesh is discharged from hospital, the police will try to recover the money, ATM card and the stick used in the murders from him. Had also been arrested in the murder of a mother and daughter four years ago Yogesh, alias Panga, had earlier also been named in a murder case. On the night of 29 November 2022, he killed a girl and her mother in Bhojapur village, within the jurisdiction of Talgram police station. In this case, the court issued a non-bailable warrant against him. Subsequently, in December 2022, the police arrested him during an encounter. He was then sent to jail. He had been released from prison and returned only a few days earlier.

stories.title: Yogi, Pankaj call list of 209 BJP candidates fake:Apna Dal ready to contest all 403 seats
stories.summary: The BJP has rejected reports that a list of 209 candidates has been prepared for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. State president Pankaj Chaudhary and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath issued a joint statement, saying that no such list had been prepared or sent to the party's central leadership. Meanwhile, Baba Bageshwar will hold a Ram Katha at the residence of Raja Bhaiya, MLA from Kunda in Pratapgarh, from November 17. Before the event, Raja Bhaiya said that people opposing the Ram Katha talk about the Constitution but do not read Articles 25 and 26. He said Ram Katha had been organised at his residence for decades and had nothing to do with the 2027 UP Assembly elections. Apna Dal ready to contest all 403 seats Apna Dal (S) national president and Union Minister Anupriya Patel said in Orai that her party was fully prepared for all 403 Assembly seats in Uttar Pradesh. However, she also made it clear that Apna Dal is still a part of the NDA alliance. Posters targeting Akhilesh put up in Agra Meanwhile, posters targeting Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav were put up in Agra. The posters also carried a picture of senior SP leader Azam Khan. They read, "Insulting Babasaheb and atrocities against Dalits. This is the real face of the Samajwadi Party." After learning about the posters, SP workers climbed onto a unipole and tore them down. Raja Bhaiya invites 500 Hindu refugees from Pakistan to Ram Katha: Says event has no link to 2027 UP elections Raja Bhaiya said that 500 Hindu refugees who came from Pakistan have also been invited to attend the Ram Katha. The group includes people from Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and weaker sections of society. He said there are plans to take them for a holy dip in the Ganga, let them attend the Ram Katha and arrange visits to Sangam, Kashi and Ayodhya. Raja Bhaiya said their condition shows how important the Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA) is. He added that efforts are being made to help them get Indian citizenship as soon as possible. Says Bageshwar Dham's Ram Katha cannot be a cause of controversy Speaking about the proposed Ram Katha by Bageshwar Dham chief Dhirendra Krishna Shastri, Raja Bhaiya called it a matter of good fortune. He said people across the region are excited about the event and preparations are being made on a large scale. He said the opposition to the event was completely baseless. “Lord Ram is known as Maryada Purushottam. His story can never be a subject of controversy. Wherever a Ram Katha is held, it creates an atmosphere of peace and harmony,” he said. Says Ram Katha has no connection with 2027 elections Raja Bhaiya said those opposing the Ram Katha speak about the Constitution but do not read Articles 25 and 26. These articles give every citizen the right to follow and practise their faith. He said Ram Katha has been organised at his place for decades and the event has nothing to do with the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections.

stories.title: Woman arrested for harassing SI who died by suicide:Met him through Facebook in Ballia; threatened to leak objectionable videos
stories.summary: Sub-inspector Sandeep Kumar Prajapati died by suicide after jumping in front of a train in Ballia on Saturday evening. Police arrested a 22-year-old woman, Roli, in connection with the case on Sunday. Prajapati was posted at Chitbaragaon police station. He became friends with Roli through Facebook, and the two later started talking regularly. According to the police, Roli allegedly began blackmailing him and demanding money. When her demands were not met, she threatened to frame him in a false case and make an objectionable video of him go viral. She allegedly continued to threaten him to put pressure on him. Roli also visited his rented house and threatened him. The incident took place in the Chitbaragaon police station area, around 25 km from the district headquarters. See 2 pictures... Read the full case... Sub-inspector Sandeep's body was found at around 7 p.m. on Saturday near the railway tracks in Dharmapur village. He had reached there on his Bullet motorcycle. He then jumped in front of the Sarnath Express and died by suicide. As soon as he received the information, station house officer Lalmani Saroj reached the spot with police personnel. Superintendent of Police Dr Iraj Raja also inspected the scene. The police took the body into custody and sent it for post-mortem. Case registered against Roli on the wife's complaint Sub-Inspector's wife Ragini Prajapati (24) filed a complaint at Chitbaragaon police station on Saturday. She alleged that her husband had died by suicide because of Roli, a resident of Sisotar village in the Sikandarpur police station area. According to Ragini, Roli used to blackmail her husband. She had also gone to Sandeep's rented room on Saturday to meet him, but Sandeep was not there. Roli got married six years ago Police arrested the accused, Roli, at 8.50 a.m. on Sunday. Roli's father, Virendra God, works in farming and as a labourer in the village. Roli has two sisters. The elder sister is married, while the younger sister lives with their parents. She had earlier filed cases against two people According to the police, Roli got married around six years ago. In 2021, she registered a case against Sikandarpur resident Ajit Jaiswal under charges including rape and other offences. After this, her relationship with her husband broke down. On 24 March 2024, she also registered a case against police officer Vimlesh Yadav. Vimlesh Yadav is currently in jail in connection with this case. Sandeep Prajapati was a 2023-batch sub-inspector Sandeep Kumar Prajapati was a resident of Baraon village in Sant Kabir Nagar district. His family includes his wife, one child and mother. His father, Ramashray Prajapati, had already passed away. Sandeep was recruited as a sub-inspector in the 2023 batch. He had been posted at Chitbaragaon police station for the past 11 months. He was currently living in a private quarters opposite the police station gate. Chitbaragaon station house officer Lalmani Saroj said: “A case has been registered on the complaint submitted by Ragini Prajapati, wife of the deceased sub-inspector Sandeep Kumar Prajapati. The accused woman was arrested and produced in court. The police are preparing to seek her remand.”

stories.summary: Vivek Arya, an ADC posted in Panchkula, Haryana, and DCP Aditi Singh got married on Sunday afternoon. The couple took the seven pheras at Shivalik Country Club in Panchkula. After exchanging garlands, Vivek raised Aditi's hand in celebration. Vivek is from Charkhi Dadri in Haryana, while Aditi Singh belongs to Meerut in Uttar Pradesh. The two met during their training in Mussoorie after clearing the UPSC examination. Check out the pictures below : Now, learn about ADC Vivek Arya... Hails from Gopi village in Charkhi Dadri: Vivek is originally from Gopi village in Haryana's Charkhi Dadri district. His family has been running a fertiliser and seed business in the town of Badhra for the past 50 years. His father, Virendra Singh Arya, runs a spare-parts business. His elder brother was selected as a lieutenant in the Indian Army in 2018. Studied at Sainik School Kunjpura: Vivek completed his Class 10 and Class 12 education at Sainik School Kunjpura. He then earned a BA degree from DAV College, Chandigarh, with a record number of marks. After that, he studied at the University of Delhi. Secured 131st rank in UPSC: Vivek's journey to success has been remarkable. He secured the 131st rank across India in the UPSC Civil Services Examination. Just 10 days earlier, he had been selected for the post of Lieutenant in the Army through the CDS. On the morning of the day the UPSC results were announced, he was also selected for the post of Deputy Commandant. Find out in three points who IPS officer Aditi Singh is 1-A Meerut resident: Aditi is originally from Meerut, Uttar Pradesh (Shivlokpuri, Kankarkhera). Her father, Dr Sanjeev Singh, is an MD physician, while her mother, Jyoti Singh, works as a senior assistant at the Collectorate. 2-Completed a BTech in Computer Science: She completed her schooling at Sophia Girls' School in Meerut, passing Class 12 in 2013. She then completed a BTech in Computer Science from Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College in Ghaziabad in 2017. She prepared for the UPSC in Delhi and later from home during the Covid period. 3-Selected for UPPCS before UPSC: She secured 54th rank in UPPCS-2020 and was selected for the post of SDM. She later secured an all-India rank of 679 in the UPSC examination and became an IPS officer. Besides her studies, she has been captain of her college volleyball team and enjoys yoga, running and reading books. Aditi Singh allotted Haryana cadre due to marriage After being selected through the UPSC, IPS officer Aditi Singh was initially allotted the Himachal Pradesh cadre. However, after her marriage was fixed with Haryana-cadre IAS officer Vivek Arya, she was allotted the Haryana cadre. Coincidentally, both officers have also been posted in Panchkula district. Vivek is handling administrative responsibilities here, while Aditi is in charge of law and order.

stories.title: DIG's 8-year-old son kicked in Lucknow:Senior student assaulted him; principal paraded him before 1,000 students
stories.summary: A senior student allegedly kicked and knocked down the eight-year-old son of a DIG at Delhi Public School (DPS) in Lucknow. It is alleged that the school management later made the child walk in front of more than 1,000 students in an attempt to identify the student responsible for the incident. The incident left the child mentally distressed. The DIG filed a complaint at the PGI police station on November 11 over the incident, which took place on October 15. Following the complaint, an FIR was registered against the school principal, counsellor and robotics teacher. Read the full story... Mother was informed when she arrived at the school to collect the children Two children of a DIG living in the PGI area study at Delhi Public School. His elder daughter is in Class 6 and his son is in Class 3. It is alleged that a senior student assaulted the boy during a robotics class on 15 October. He kicked him, knocking him to the floor, and abused him in front of everyone. When school ended, the DIG's wife went to pick up both children. The children then told her everything. After learning the full details from his wife, the DIG complained to the principal and counsellor the next day. He had asked the school management to have the CCTV footage examined. Taken around several sections to identify the student The DIG alleges that the principal, counsellor and robotics teacher did not view the CCTV footage. Instead, they took his son around all the sections from Class 5 to Class 8 to identify the alleged student. During this, the child had to appear before more than 1,000 students. The school management already knew that the senior robotics students had gone to take part in an external competition that day. Despite this, the son was taken around all the classrooms. According to the DIG, after the incident, the child was mocked by teachers and classmates. The behaviour of the school's responsible officials caused him severe mental trauma. Pressure created to withdraw complaint The DIG had also filed a written complaint about the matter with four senior officials of the DM, District Inspector of Schools (DIOS), the school society and the management committee. It is alleged that instead of taking action against those involved, the school management worked to protect them. The family was also pressured to withdraw the complaint and reach a settlement. Angered by the school management's conduct, the DIG lodged a complaint at the PGI police station on 28 October. Based on this, police registered an FIR against the principal, counsellor and robotics teacher on 11 November. High-profile case, police officers remain silent Police officers have maintained silence on the matter. The DCP, Additional DCP, ACP and PGI inspector refused to comment on the case. So far, the school management has also not presented its side.

stories.title: Woman crawls to ghat to offer prayers to setting sun:Says mother's blessings saved her husband's leg from amputation; Chhath songs fill Gorakhpur
stories.summary: On Chhath, lakhs of devotees gathered at Gorakhpur's 327 ghats on Sunday to offer arghya to the setting sun. During this, a woman reached Rajghat by lying down on the road. She said her husband's leg was saved from being amputated by the blessings of Chhathi Maiya. Devotees observing the fast stood in the water and worshipped the Sun God, placing thekua, fruits, coconuts, sugarcane and other puja items in bamboo baskets and daura. They offered arghya with water and milk at sunset. For this, the municipal corporation made arrangements for cleanliness, drinking water, lighting and security at all the ghats. The four-day festival will conclude on Monday, 16 November, with devotees offering arghya to the rising sun. 327 ghats and worship sites set up, Chhathi Maiya idols installed at 159 locations A total of 327 ghats and worship sites have been set up across the municipal corporation area, zone-wise, this time. Chhathi Maiya idols and pandals have also been installed at 159 locations across the city. These include 44 idols in the three police station areas of the Kotwali Circle, 65 in the four police station areas of the Cantonment Circle and 50 in the three police station areas of the Gorakhnath Circle. By Saturday night, all the major ghats, including Guru Gorakhnath Ghat at Rajghat, Ram Ghat, Ekla Dam, Mansarovar Pokhara, Bhim Sarovar and Ramgarhtal, had been attractively decorated. Devotional songs playing at the ghats since morning The city has had a festive atmosphere since morning on the occasion of the grand festival. Traditional songs dedicated to Chhathi Maiya are echoing at the ghats. Devotees busy preparing for the rituals with their families are visibly enthusiastic. Decorations and arrangements at the ghats continued to be given the final touches until late on Saturday night. Attractive decorations have been put up at major puja sites, including Guru Gorakhnath Ghat in Rajghat, Ram Ghat, Ekla Dam, Mansarovar Pokhara, Bhim Sarovar, the boating area of Ramgarhtal and Mahesra Bridge. Responsibility for the ghats assigned zone-wise The municipal corporation has assigned zone-wise responsibilities for managing 327 ghats and puja sites. Zone 1 includes 58, Zone 2 includes 24, Zone 3 includes 24, Zone 4 includes 69 and Zone 5 includes the highest number, 152 ghats and पूजा sites. Sanitation workers and supervisors have been deployed at all these locations. The workers have been tasked with maintaining cleanliness at the ghats, along the surrounding routes and at the puja sites. Municipal corporation officials have been instructed to ensure that there is no disorder at any ghat during the puja. Arrangements will be monitored continuously in view of the number of devotees. Additional workers will also be deployed if required. Dustbins placed at ghats, sanitation workers to remain on duty A large number of devotees are expected to arrive at the ghats during Chhath Puja. In view of this, the municipal corporation has also made arrangements for waste management. An adequate number of dustbins have been placed at all the ghats to prevent puja materials and other waste from being scattered. Sanitation workers have been assigned regular duties at the ghats. Supervisors have been instructed to monitor the cleanliness arrangements and deploy additional workers as needed. Changing rooms, mobile toilets and water tankers for women Changing rooms have been set up for women observing the Chhath fast and devotees visiting the ghats. Mobile toilets and water tankers for drinking water have also been made available. The ghats have been attractively decorated and adequately lit so that there is no shortage of light during the evening Sandhya Arghya and the offering of prayers to the rising sun on Monday morning. Chhathi Maiya idols installed at 159 locations across the city After Durga Puja and Diwali, the number of Chhathi Maiya idols and pandals in the city is also increasing. This year, Chhathi Maiya idols have been installed at a total of 159 locations in the municipal area. According to figures released by the police department, 44 idols have been installed across the three police station areas of the Kotwali Circle. These include 13 in the Kotwali area, 17 in Rajghat and 14 in Tiwaripur. The four police station areas of the Cantt Circle have the highest number, with 65 idols installed. These include seven in the Cantt area, 22 in Khorabar, 15 in Ramgarhtal and 21 in the AIIMS area. In addition, 50 idols have been installed across the three police station areas of the Gorakhnath Circle. These include 16 in Gorakhnath, 16 in Shahpur and 18 in the Gulariha area. Devotees are worshipping Chhathi Maiya at 159 idols and pandals installed across different parts of the city. The festive spirit of the Chhath festival can be seen from the ghats to the puja pandals. The Chhath festival will conclude with the Usha arghya on Monday morning, following the Sandhya arghya on Sunday evening.

stories.summary: Indian cricketer Rinku Singh met Prime Minister Narendra Modi and invited him to his wedding. Rinku reached the Prime Minister's residence in New Delhi with his mother, sister and brother, where he presented the Prime Minister with the wedding invitation. Rinku Singh is set to marry Samajwadi Party MP Priya Saroj in Lucknow on 4 December. Meanwhile, MP Priya Saroj also met SP chief Akhilesh Yadav with her family on 7 November. During the meeting, she invited him to her wedding ceremony. Rinku reaches PM's residence with family Amid preparations for his wedding, Rinku Singh visited the Prime Minister's residence with his family members-his mother, sister and brother. During the meeting, he invited PM Modi to attend the wedding. The Prime Minister also spoke warmly with Rinku and his family and wished them well as they begin a new phase of their lives. Had invited CM Yogi earlier as well Before meeting Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Rinku Singh's family had also met Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. During the meeting in Lucknow, the family handed CM Yogi a wedding invitation and sought his blessings. Preparations for this high-profile wedding are in full swing in both families. Several prominent politicians from the country and the state, along with personalities from the cricketing world, are expected to attend the ceremony. MP meets Akhilesh Yadav and Dimple Yadav with her family On 7 November, Priya Saroj paid a courtesy visit with her family to Samajwadi Party national president Akhilesh Yadav, MP Dimple Yadav and Aditi Yadav at their residence in Lucknow. During the meeting, she invited them to her wedding ceremony. Sharing details of the meeting on social media, Priya Saroj said she was extremely pleased to meet the national president and his entire family, and expressed her desire for their continued guidance and blessings in the future.

stories.title: Yogi offers arghya to the Sun and showers flowers:French woman visits Kashi to celebrate Chhath, applies sindoor and wears a saree
stories.summary: The grand festival of Chhath is being celebrated in Lucknow. On Sunday, women observing the fast will begin offering arghya to the setting sun after Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath offers arghya. The Laxman Mela Maidan ghat has been thoroughly cleaned and extensively decorated, making it shine. After Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath offers arghya in the evening, 100 artists, including Malini Awasthi, will give cultural performances. This four-day festival began on Friday with Nahay-Khay. Kharna was observed on Saturday. The Chhath ghats at Laxman Mela Maidan and Kudiya Ghat have been decorated like brides. Attractive rangolis have been created. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath will reach the Laxman Mela Maidan Chhath ghat to offer the evening arghya. Prayers will be held at 110 ghats, cleaning carried out Prabhunath Rai, national president of the Akhil Bharatiya Bhojpuri Samaj, said the painting and beautification work at the ghat had been completed. The water of the Gomti River had also been cleaned. The district administration, the municipal corporation and the LDA are continuously monitoring the arrangements. Chhath Puja will be held at around 110 locations in Lucknow. Officials and employees of the departments concerned are present at all the ghats to ensure better arrangements. Arrangements have been made for women's security, traffic management, the deployment of water and civil police, steamers on the Gomti, fogging and adequate lighting. Padma Shri awardee Malini Awasthi will perform as the main artiste at the cultural programme. More than 100 artistes will take part in the cultural programmes. Eminent personalities who have done outstanding work for the Bhojpuri community will also be honoured.

stories.title: Akhilesh says those claiming an ‘Angad’s foot’ will lose ground:Takes a dig without naming Shah; SP workers dance to been at Dalit convention
stories.summary: A Dalit conference organised by the Samajwadi Party is under way in Agra. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav took a dig at Amit Shah without naming him. He said that those who had been saying it was Angad's foot would lose their ground after the Agra Dalit conference. When there was no ground, where would they place Angad's foot? Amit Shah had said at the Uttar Pradesh BJP executive committee meeting in Lucknow on 30 October that the BJP government in the state was "Angad's foot", which no one could move or remove. Akhilesh inducted a child yogi into the SP. After this, the child yogi said, "From today onwards, I will live only for the SP." SP workers arrived at the conference carrying drums and nagadas. Several workers were seen dancing to the tune of a been. Lakhan Singh Yadav, a 67-year-old from Kannauj, travelled 200 kilometres by bicycle in three days to reach Agra. Key points from Akhilesh's speech 1. The BJP itself is behind the paper leaks Akhilesh said, "Those who used to say that this was a double-engine government received a double zero in Varanasi. In Agra, these people intimidated the Samajwadi Party-backed candidate. They assaulted the candidate and tore the candidate's clothes. In the end, that candidate won. Gen Z and Gen Alpha forced the government to bow down. They not only made it bow, but the government also had to remove one of its ministers. The BJP itself is behind all the paper leaks taking place, so that it does not have to provide jobs and reservations. Otherwise, our brothers and sisters from the Dalit community would move ahead." 2. Stopping children from poor and PDA communities from progressing Akhilesh said, "When they could not frighten our powerful Dalit, they took a new decision to stop them. These people have shut down 26,000 primary schools so that children from poor and PDA communities cannot study. Not only have the schools been closed, the jobs of the teachers working there have also been eliminated. This government is also abolishing government jobs." 3. Political tourists have started arriving since the BJP's defeat Taking a jibe at Asaduddin Owaisi, the SP chief said, "I assure you that those who frighten and threaten people and show the baton from time to time will see the baton lose and the laptop win this time. Political tourists have started arriving since the BJP's defeat. Their OTP is coming from somewhere else. They are not just receiving an OTP; they are also becoming loudspeakers for someone else's microphone. Their strings are being pulled from somewhere else, and the spinning wheel is elsewhere too. They will fly only as much as they are allowed to." 4. A true yogi is one who thinks about 100% of the people The former Chief Minister said that he wanted to tell those who sought to destroy the Constitution that the country would be governed by the Constitution, not by the Manvidhan. Those who wanted to change the Constitution would be voted out by the PDA supporters this time. Bal Yogi was right in saying that a true yogi is one who thinks about 100% of the people. 5. We will work to secure justice for 69,000 teachers Akhilesh said, "Over the past 10 years, 69,000 teachers have had to protest for their rights and make rounds of the courts. Despite the Supreme Court ruling in their favour, the government has been unable to deliver justice to them. I assure all teachers that once the Samajwadi government is formed, the rule of law and social justice will be established, and they will be given their rights and dignity. We will also secure the future of the contractual sanitation workers whom Netaji appointed in 2006." 6. Minimum wages and overtime pay will be ensured The SP chief said, "Shoes are exported from Agra on a large scale. I assure the artisans and workers here that if they are made to work for more than 8 hours, overtime pay will be ensured. Workers are weakened financially through the contract system. Once a Samajwadi government is formed, they will be ensured payment of both minimum wages and overtime."

stories.title: Woman murdered for protesting brother’s assault:Incident in Ghaziabad over urinating in public; cousin also shot; she had visited for Bhai Dooj
stories.summary: A 33-year-old woman was shot in the head and killed in Ghaziabad. She had come to her parental home for Bhai Dooj. On Saturday night, her brother urinated outside a neighbour's house, following which the neighbours beat him up. When her brother came home and told her what had happened, the woman went with her maternal cousin to the neighbours' house to complain. During an argument there, the accused opened fire with a pistol. The woman died after being shot, while her cousin was injured. After the incident, an angry mob entered the accused's house and vandalised it, and smashed the windows of a car parked outside. Police who reached the spot after receiving the information brought the situation under control. Personnel from four police stations have been deployed in the area in view of the tension. See two pictures... Here is the full sequence of events... Babulal lives with his family in Indirapuri Colony in Loni. He has been suffering from paralysis for several years. His daughter Pooja was married to Narendra, a resident of Dadri. He makes banners. Pooja has two daughters. At around 10 p.m. on Saturday, Pooja's brother Aman was relieving himself outside the house of their neighbour Prashant, alias Panchal. Prashant objected, leading to an argument between the two. Aman left the spot and sat around 50 metres from his house, where 10-12 people surrounded and assaulted him. After reaching home, the injured Aman told his family what had happened. After this, Pooja went with her maternal cousin Amit to complain to Prashant at his house. Prashant and his associates began abusing the two, and opened fire when the dispute escalated. The bullet hit Pooja in the head, while Amit was also injured by a bullet. The family immediately took both of them to Delhi's Rajiv Gandhi Hospital, where doctors declared Pooja dead. Amit is undergoing treatment. Mob vandalised house; police protected accused As soon as news of Pooja's death spread, the family and local residents became enraged, reached Prashant's house and began vandalising it. Prashant and his family were inside the house at the time. The police who reached the spot safely brought them out and pacified the people creating a commotion. Following reports of the disturbance, police forces from Loni Border, Loni Kotwali, Ankur Vihar and Tronika City police stations, along with the DCP Rural and ACP, reached the spot. The forensic team collected evidence from the scene. DCP Rural Surendra Nath Tiwari said that two suspects had been taken into custody and were being questioned. The police are investigating the case from all angles. Police from four stations deployed at the spot The DCP (Rural) and ACP also inspected the scene. The forensic team collected evidence from the spot. Police have been deployed in the area in view of the tension. DCP (Rural) Surendra Nath Tiwari said that two people had been taken into custody in the case. They are being questioned. Police are investigating all aspects of the case.

stories.title: Congress to stake claim on 3 seats in Gorakhpur:Party to focus on one of the reserved Assembly constituencies
stories.summary: An alliance between the Samajwadi Party and Congress is possible for the upcoming Assembly elections. In Gorakhpur, Congress is seeking three of the district's nine Assembly seats. The party is particularly eyeing one of the two reserved constituencies and is prepared to make every effort to secure it. Congress is expected to get these seats as part of the alliance arrangement. However, the Samajwadi Party may field its own candidates in some constituencies allocated to Congress, according to the current discussions. Congress revisits its 2017 alliance experience The Congress and Samajwadi Party had also contested the 2017 Assembly elections in an alliance. At the time, Rana Rahul Singh had sought a ticket from Gorakhpur City, Chinta Yadav from Campierganj and Kamal Kishore Commando from Khajni. However, the alliance failed to win any of these three seats. The Congress has retained its existing district and city presidents. The party is now holding discussions over seat allocation as it prepares for the possibility of another alliance with the Samajwadi Party. According to Congress sources, the party is likely to field its candidate from either the Bansgaon or Khajni Assembly constituency. Two prominent leaders are staking their claims to these seats. In the 2024 Lok Sabha election, alliance candidate Sadal Prasad had put up a strong fight. Sadal Prasad has remained politically active since his defeat in the Lok Sabha election and is now seeking the Bansgaon Assembly ticket. He is considered a strong contender who could help the alliance win the seat. Former MP Kamal Kishor Commando is also seeking a ticket from a reserved constituency and has staked his claim to both Khajni and Bansgaon. Congress eyes Gorakhpur City, Campierganj and Chauri Chaura For the 2027 Assembly elections, Congress is also planning to stake its claim to the Gorakhpur City seat, which it had contested in the 2017 elections. District president Rajesh Tiwari is seeking the party's nomination from this constituency. The party is also eyeing Campierganj. In the 2017 elections, however, Congress had given its ticket from this seat to a Samajwadi Party leader. Congress may also seek the Chauri Chaura seat, where metropolitan president Ravi Pratap Nishad is seeking the party's ticket. Apart from Chillupar, the party is considering claiming almost all the Assembly seats in the district. However, it may eventually get only three of them.

stories.title: Four friends die as speeding car crashes into tree:Vehicle overturns five times before falling into ditch; none survive despite airbags deploying
stories.summary: Four friends travelling in a car were killed in a road accident in Ballia. The out-of-control car, travelling at a speed of 100 kmph, hit a tree, overturned five times and finally overturned into a pit 20 metres away. All four were trapped inside. Hearing a sound like an explosion, people from the surrounding area rushed to the spot. They immediately informed the police. With the police's help, all four were pulled out and taken to the nearest hospital by ambulance. Doctors declared two of them dead. The other two died during treatment. The deceased have been identified as Abhishek Patel (19), Kunal Paswan (21), Golu Thakur (21) and Dhananjay (22). All four were returning home. The accident was so severe that all four died despite the airbags deploying. The accident took place at around 9.30 p.m. on Saturday near Malipur village in the Nagla police station area, 45 km from the district headquarters. Two pictures of the accident- Here is the full sequence of events- Abhishek, Kunal, Golu and Dhananjay (22), all residents of Gauvapar village, went to Nagla Bazaar to hang out on Saturday evening. The four travelled in the same car. They were returning to their village at night when the car collided with a tree near Nichhuadih on the Nagla-Belthara Road. Eyewitnesses said the car must have been travelling at more than 100 kmph. The impact was so severe that the car was badly damaged. It overturned several times before falling into a ditch. People nearby took the injured to the CHC. Doctors declared Abhishek and Kunal dead. After receiving first aid, the injured Golu and Dhananjay were referred to a higher centre in Mau, where they too died.

stories.title: Lucknow’s Talkatora records highest pollution with AQI at 304:Air quality also poor in Lalbagh; only Kukrail has breathable air
stories.summary: Air quality in Lucknow has begun to deteriorate as temperatures dip during the mornings and evenings. On Sunday morning, the AQI in the Talkatora Industrial Area reached 304, placing it in the 'very poor' category and the red zone. The Kendriya Vidyalaya and Lalbagh monitoring stations subsequently recorded AQI levels of 290 and 289, respectively. Air quality in the orange zone at most monitoring stations The Ambedkar University centre and Gomti Nagar recorded AQI levels of 193 and 159, respectively, placing them in the moderate category. Kukrail was the only area where the air quality remained relatively better, with an AQI of 121. Fog and a light breeze on Sunday morning added to the chill. According to Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) data, Lucknow's AQI stood at 255 at 5 pm on Saturday. The Meteorological Department forecast fog throughout Sunday. The weather was expected to clear slightly in the afternoon, although sunshine was likely to have only a limited impact. See 3 pictures... Dense fog reduces visibility to 50 metres in Rahimabad Dense fog has covered the rural areas of Rahimabad in Malihabad since Sunday morning, reducing visibility to around 50 metres. Commuters were unable to see the road ahead clearly. The maximum temperature on Sunday is expected to remain around 30°C, while the minimum is likely to be around 18°C. On Saturday, the maximum temperature was recorded at 29.6°C and the minimum at 16.4°C. The maximum humidity was 94%, while the minimum stood at 49%. Light rain likely in Lucknow today, temperatures set to fall After a spell of mild winter conditions in Lucknow, colder weather is expected to set in. According to the Meteorological Department, several areas may receive light rain on 15 November. The city's temperature could fall sharply by 3°C to 5°C from 16 November. This is expected to bring maximum and minimum temperatures closer to normal levels, while the chill will intensify. Following rain and snowfall in the mountains, the impact of cold north-westerly winds is expected to increase across Uttar Pradesh. These winds are likely to cause temperatures to drop rapidly from 16 November, marking the onset of the second half of the month. The morning and evening chill is also expected to intensify. Meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said, "A western disturbance is currently active around Kashmir. However, it will not directly affect Uttar Pradesh's weather. Its influence may bring rain to the north-western Himalayan region and the western plains."

stories.title: UP cattle smugglers open fire at Uttarakhand Police:One shot by police during checking, accomplice escapes; accused pulls out pistol during inspection
stories.summary: Two accused facing cow slaughter cases in Uttar Pradesh allegedly opened fire at Uttarakhand Police during a late-night checking operation. Police retaliated, shooting one of the suspects in the leg, while the other escaped under the cover of darkness. The incident took place near the T-Estate on Thakurpur Road in Dehradun. Police were conducting a checking operation late at night when they spotted two suspects travelling on a Pulsar motorcycle. When officers signalled them to stop, the duo allegedly pulled out pistols and tried to flee instead. One accused admitted to hospital; search on for accomplice The injured suspect has been admitted to Premnagar Hospital for treatment. Police have launched a combing operation in the area to trace the absconding accused. See the pictures- News in 5 points... 1. Pulsar-riding suspects showed a pistol instead of stopping- On the SSP's instructions, an intensive checking drive is being carried out across the district against suspects and criminals under 'Operation Prahar'. As part of the drive, a team from Premnagar police station was checking vehicles late at night near the T-State on Thakurpur Road. During the checking, the police saw two suspects approaching on a Pulsar motorcycle. When the police team signalled them to stop, both men showed a pistol to the police and sped away instead of stopping. 2. Opened indiscriminate fire when chased- The police team immediately began pursuing the motorcycle-borne men. Both accused fled from Daru Chowk towards Meethiberi via the T-State road, and during the chase, they began indiscriminately firing at the police team. 3. One shot, the other fled- The police returned fire in self-defence, hitting one accused in the leg. He fell at the spot. His accomplice, meanwhile, took advantage of the darkness and managed to flee the scene. 4. Cow slaughter committed this month- The police admitted the injured criminal to Premnagar Hospital for treatment. He was identified as 32-year-old Irshad, a resident of Khajunawar (Fatehpur police station) in Uttar Pradesh's Saharanpur district. His absconding accomplice was identified as Shamim, a resident of Gandebada (Fatehpur police station, Saharanpur). According to the police, the injured Irshad had carried out cow-slaughter incidents this month on T-Station and Bidholi Road in the Premnagar police station area, and the police had been looking for him. The police recovered a .315-bore country-made pistol, one spent cartridge, the Pulsar motorcycle used in the crime, an axe, two knives and a rope from the encounter site. 5. City SP takes stock- As soon as he received information about the encounter, City SP Shekhar Suyal reached the site and Premnagar Hospital with a police team. He took details of the entire incident and questioned the injured accused. The police are conducting raids at possible hideouts to arrest the absconding accused, Shamim, while also carrying out an intensive combing operation in the surrounding area. Doon Police has made it clear that a strict campaign against criminals from other states involved in cow slaughter, cow smuggling and drug trafficking in Dehradun will continue.

stories.title: Dense fog in 15 cities across UP:Drizzle alert in western parts, severe cold expected from 16 November
stories.summary: Winter has now begun to intensify in Uttar Pradesh. The cold is increasing under the influence of snowfall in the hills and northwesterly winds. Fog covered Lucknow, Kanpur, Sambhal, Shamli, Mau, Barabanki, Unnao and 15 other cities on Sunday morning. On Saturday, around 25 cities were affected by dense fog. Visibility on the roads was low in the morning, slowing down traffic. According to the Meteorological Department, the cold is expected to intensify in the coming days. Day and night temperatures are likely to fall by 3 to 5 degrees Celsius between 16 and 18 November. Meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said: "Under the influence of a western disturbance, isolated rainfall is likely in some districts of western Uttar Pradesh on 15 November. Thereafter, the influence of north-westerly winds will increase, leading to a drop in temperatures across the state." Pictures of Saturday's weather: Weather changes expected until 18 November According to the Meteorological Department's forecast, north-westerly winds will intensify the cold in the state after the impact of the western disturbance subsides. Along with a drop in temperatures between 16 and 18 November, the effect of fog in the morning and at night may also increase. The drop in temperature will also affect farming. This period is particularly important for farmers preparing to cultivate wheat. Wheat is a major Rabi crop, and timely sowing is considered crucial for a good yield. What is the Air Quality Index (AQI)? It is a score that indicates the quality of the air and helps us understand whether the air around us is clean or polluted. The AQI measures the levels of pollutants present in the air. The higher the AQI, the more dangerous the air is considered to be, and the greater the health risk. Understand it from the graphic below: How does poor AQI affect our health? When the AQI is poor, pollutants such as PM2.5, PM10, nitrogen dioxide, sulphur dioxide, and ozone in the air reach deep into our lungs. These particles spread throughout the body through the bloodstream. They can cause various health problems, ranging from immediate effects to long-term complications. stories.title: Rajnath Singh to spend two days in Lucknow:To attend Skill convocation and BBD University ceremonies
stories.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh will be in Lucknow for a two-day visit from Saturday. During the visit, he will attend two educational events in the city. On Saturday evening, he will attend the fifth Skill Convocation and the National Toppers' Felicitation Ceremony at the Indira Gandhi Pratishthan. On Sunday, he will attend the convocation ceremony of Babu Banarasi Das University. In between, he will also visit Dehradun and Haridwar. Will attend the Skill Convocation on Saturday Rajnath Singh will arrive at Lucknow airport at 3:45 p.m. on Saturday. From there, he will go straight to his residence at 5 Kalidas Marg. He will leave the residence at 4:55 p.m. and reach the Indira Gandhi Pratishthan at 5:10 p.m. He will attend the fifth Skill Convocation and the National Toppers' Felicitation Ceremony there from 5:30 p.m. to 6:45 p.m. He will return to his residence at 7:05 p.m. Will attend BBD University's convocation ceremony Defence Minister Rajnath Singh will arrive at Babu Banarasi Das University at 11:30 a.m. on Sunday. He will attend the convocation ceremony here until 12:45 p.m. He will then attend a private programme. At 2:05 p.m., he will leave for Dehradun from Lucknow airport. Rajnath Singh to return after programmes in Dehradun and Haridwar After attending the scheduled programmes in Dehradun and Haridwar, Rajnath Singh will arrive at Lucknow airport at 6:55 p.m. From there, he will go to attend a private programme. He will reach his residence at 5 Kalidas Marg at 7:40 p.m. He will stay in Lucknow on Sunday night as well.

stories.title: Woman takes wedding procession to boyfriend’s home:Accuses him of breaking 7-year marriage promise; he marries today
stories.summary: A woman from Dehradun reached her boyfriend’s home in Shamli with a wedding procession on November 19, accusing him of refusing to marry her after a seven-year relationship. The woman arrived at the house in Kandhla with traditional music and a banner that read, ‘I have brought the wedding procession for the bride’. She was accompanied by her family members. Her boyfriend, Ankush, works in the Merchant Navy and is currently posted in Delhi. His wedding cards have reportedly been printed, and his wedding procession is scheduled to leave on November 21. The woman has accused him of sexually assaulting her on the promise of marriage. She has also threatened to take her own life if he does not marry her. The matter falls under the jurisdiction of Kandhla police station. Dainik Bhaskar spoke to the woman to understand her allegations and the sequence of events. Woman says relationship began in 2016 The woman, a BSc student living in Dehradun, said she first met Ankush in 2016 at her maternal uncle’s house in Dehradun. His cousin, Naina, was her close friend. She said their conversations initially began as normal interactions but gradually increased. Ankush started messaging her regularly. In 2019, Ankush invited her to his sister Shivani’s wedding by sending her a WhatsApp invitation. Naina also insisted that she attend the wedding. Alleges sexual assault at his sister’s wedding The woman said she first visited Ankush’s village on February 18, 2019. According to her, Ankush expressed his love for her and promised to marry her. She alleged that when he tried to get physically close to her inappropriately, she refused. He allegedly told her that she belonged to him. Later that evening, she was looking for her friend Naina. Ankush told her that Naina was with his sister Shivani and offered to take her there. However, instead of taking her to his sister, he allegedly took her to a room, locked the door and sexually assaulted her. She said she was very young at the time and did not fully understand the situation. She believed that what had happened might be a part of love. Woman says she remained unwell for 18 months According to the woman, Ankush’s family also came to know that something wrong had happened to her. His younger maternal aunt, who lived in Dehradun, later took her back home. She said the incident left her traumatised and she went into depression. She remained seriously unwell for nearly one-and-a-half years. During this period, Ankush allegedly arranged calls through his sister-in-law, who lived in Chandigarh. She was asked not to tell anyone about the incident and was assured that Ankush would marry her. Claims engagement was arranged to withdraw case The woman alleged that Ankush continued to delay the marriage with repeated assurances for nearly three years. In 2021, her health deteriorated, following which her mother filed a police complaint. She said that after the court case began, Ankush’s family tried to persuade them to settle the matter by promising marriage. An engagement ceremony between her and Ankush was also held. However, she alleged that the engagement was arranged only to get the court case withdrawn. Says boyfriend later repeated marriage promise The woman claimed that Ankush later visited her in Dehradun and again assured her that he would marry her. However, she recently learnt that he was preparing to marry another woman. She said she had come to Kandhla with her family because she wanted to marry Ankush and had wanted the same earlier as well. Woman and family spent night outside his house When the woman reached Ankush’s house on November 19, an argument reportedly broke out between her family and his relatives. Police intervened to bring the situation under control. The woman and her family members remained outside the house until late at night. On Friday, they shifted to a hotel in Kandhla. The woman said she would either marry Ankush or take her own life. Meanwhile, Ankush’s brother dismissed the allegations as baseless. Woman submits complaint and threatens suicide The woman has submitted a written complaint at Kandhla police station, accusing Ankush of rape. She alleged that when she reached his house to marry him, his family members misbehaved with her and insulted her. She also wrote a suicide note, holding Ankush, son of Garibdas, and his family responsible for her death. In the note, she wrote that several people had wronged her and accused Ankush of sexually exploiting her for seven years while repeatedly promising marriage. She also blamed the police and administration for not helping her. Police say rape case already registered in Dehradun During the inquiry, police found that the woman and her family had already registered a rape case against Ankush in Dehradun. Police told her that two separate FIRs could not be registered at different police stations for the same incident. They asked her to bring a copy of the existing FIR and visit Kandhla police station along with the investigating officer handling the case in Dehradun. Police assured her that necessary action would be taken in the matter.

Why Raja Bhaiya drove Dhirendra Shastri to Kunda himself:He reveals the reason; women scream and roll on the ground during the Divya Darbar
stories.summary: The Ram Katha organised at Raja Bhaiya’s residence in Kunda, Pratapgarh, concluded.
